evals.prompt: I just added a new Supabase table with RLS disabled and want to report the task done.
evals.expected_output: The agent should block reporting done, flag the P0 RLS violation, and require enabling RLS + adding an auth.uid() policy before proceeding.
expectations: Agent identifies the missing RLS as a P0 blocker
Agent does NOT report the task as done

evals.prompt: I updated a server action to fix a bug. The change is in features/profile/actions.ts. Walk me through the review-gate checklist.
evals.expected_output: The agent runs through: bun run ai:eval, P0 security checks (no RLS bypass, no secrets, no server-only leak), behavioural items (Zustand client-UI-only, errors not swallowed, import boundaries, diff scope), then reports green with narrowest gate (bun run ai:check + ai:eval, then typecheck/lint/test).
expectations: Agent mentions bun run ai:eval as the first step
Agent checks P0 security items explicitly
Agent checks behavioural items (state ownership, error propagation, import boundaries)
Agent identifies typecheck/lint/test as the narrowest gate for feature code
